comments.author: Maria
comments.body: Can this be burnt or eaten by rats or both?

comments.author: Naoyasu
comments.body:
It's safe from both. Rats only consume goods that are in the
Foodstuffs category (fish, beef, etc). Fire affects the following:
Foodstuffs, Luxury Goods, Spices, Medicine, Fibres, Fabrics, Fragrances, and Sundries, but not Seasonings.
